title: AMD action: getdemographic
description: Fetch one patient's demographic snapshot by patient_id or chart_number. Returns a single patient object: patient_id, insurance_plans (carrier code, carrier name, plan code, plan name, member id, group, effective dates), referral_plans (referring provider id and name, authorization number), chart_files (id, name, type, category, date_of_service), financial_class_code, ins_order. PHI redaction default ON; payer codes and ids are non-PHI; names and member ids are redacted unless elevation is in scope.

chart_number.description: Chart number; alternate lookup key. Provide this OR patient_id.

patient_id.description: AMD patient_id (numeric string). Provide this OR chart_number.
